_comment: Pinned harness (CLI) and model versions for runs from 2026-07-28.
Dated rather than mutable: the config that produced a set of results stays
readable alongside them. Start a new config_<YYYYMMDD>.json when bumping.
Data collected before 20260728 did NOT pin the harness, and those jobs span
several harness versions (claude-code 2.1.72-2.1.97, codex 0.114.0-0.118.0).
Chosen values are the most-used in harbor-jobs (claude-code 2.1.81: 8 trials,
codex 0.116.0: 12 trials), so new runs stay comparable to the published
results rather than to a version nothing was published on.
ONE entry per tool, deliberately: the agent and the judge share /root/.local/bin
inside the trial container, so whichever installs last wins. Separate agent and
judge versions could therefore never be honoured reliably -- and a single field
makes 'agent and judge run the same CLI' true by construction rather than by
remembering to keep two numbers equal.
Consumed at runtime by run_harbor.sh (model via -m, harness via --ak version=)
and by the judge paths (test.sh, rerun_verifier.sh, run_unsupervised_judges.sh)
via tests/versions.json, which is generated from this file.
Two places cannot read it and carry the values literally: each task's
environment/Dockerfile (installs the judge CLIs at image build time) and each
task's tests/versions.json. Do NOT edit those by hand -- edit this file, then:
python harbor-scripts/apply_versions.py           # rewrite all 36
python harbor-scripts/apply_versions.py --check   # report drift, exit 1
To bump: copy this to config_<newdate>.json, change the versions, run
apply_versions.py. Image layers after the CLI installs rebuild (~1-2 min);
the expensive pip layers above them stay cached.
